Bandits have again attacked Kaura-Namoda town, the headquarters of Kaura-Namoda Local Government Area of Zamfara State, where they killed one person and abducted five members of the same family. Recall that the bandits attacked Kaura-Namoda town on Saturday, killing an All Progressives Congress E-Registration Supervisor, Nasiru Sani, and abducting several people in a mosque during the early morning prayer (Subh). An indigene of the town, Nababa Musa, told The PUNCH that the bandits, who were on motorcycles, invaded the town last Sunday night, where they fired many gunshots to scare away the residents. According to Musa, the bandits later moved to the residence of one Sama’ila in the Sabuwar Kaura area, killing his watchman and abducting five of his family members. Musa said, “The bandits, who were on motorcycles, invaded our area in the middle of the night last Sunday, carrying sophisticated weapons, and started shooting separately to scare the residents and the security agents. He said, “I am aware of the incident, and Governor Dauda Lawal was personally present during the burial ceremony of one of the victims, Alhaji Nasiru Sani.” “You are living witnesses that the Governor is doing his best in the fight against insecurity.” Maiharaji Altine
